title: Kessler Care Member Points Bonus — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Member bonus.** The Kessler Care member bonus on a Service Accounts and Repair Orders paid repair order follows the customer's maintenance plans, as the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans records show, and the account's tier.

| The customer holds an active Kessler Care maintenance plan on any vehicle | Account tier | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Platinum | 150 |
| Yes | Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | 75 |
| Otherwise | — | none |

The plan need not be on the vehicle of the paid repair order; any active Kessler Care plan the customer holds counts. A plan whose status is not active does not count.
